# Confine a broken account to its placeholder and avoid repeating the failed lookup

Account Manager catches account setup errors per account, clears child panels, sets validAccount=false and continues building the list. Its chat protocol icon lookup is guarded by validAccount. about:support also catches each account and appends placeholder data, so one corrupted buddy database need not prevent diagnostics for the other accounts. This protects display and removal paths; it does not repair the database. The current placeholder still spells sokectType incorrectly, so that typo is not a naming example. A broken-profile runtime test and the placeholder accessible name were not checked here.

Scope: Account error isolation.
